peerMapping.justification: Three-run Kimi K3 consensus selected only the displayed peers: SILVER 48.2% with 3/3 replicate support; BRENTOIL 28.6% with 3/3 replicate support; GOLD 23.2% with 3/3 replicate support. Individual rationales state each economic relationship.

peers.name: Silver
peers.reason: Silver is the closest available metal peer because it combines precious-metal flows with meaningful industrial demand in electronics, solar, and electrical uses, overlapping copper's wiring and electrification demand; it also shares USD, real-rate, and commodity-index sensitivity. Its 24-hour perp liquidity is 84.785 USD millions.

peers.name: Brent crude oil
peers.reason: Brent crude oil is a directly traded global commodity tied to the same worldwide manufacturing, transport, and construction cycle as copper, and it proxies energy input costs for mining and smelting. It is less metal-specific than silver, so it receives a smaller weight; its 24-hour perp liquidity is 98.495 USD millions.

peers.name: Gold
peers.reason: Same metals complex and shared macro drivers - dollar strength, real yields, and mining input costs - but gold lacks copper's industrial-demand leg, so it earns the second weight rather than the first. Its 54.7 USD millions of 24-hour perp liquidity is ample relative to the target.

primary_index_hedge.name: S&P 500
primary_index_hedge.reason: S&P 500 is the primary risk hedge because copper is highly sensitive to global growth, financial conditions, and risk-off shocks; a short broad-equity overlay is the cleanest available hedge for that generic systematic exposure rather than evidence of copper-specific similarity.

peerMapping.historyMethod: daily-rebalanced peer spot total returns using the fixed Kimi weights; the basket begins with the first available selected peer, unavailable pre-listing peers are omitted, and remaining weights are renormalized; the browser rebases the basket to the target spot level at the first shared date of each selected chart range

liveSplice.method: current Hyperliquid native or TradeXYZ perp mid divided by that peer's matching-venue perp close on its latest spot date; available Kimi weights are renormalized and applied as a one-period return from the published peer spot endpoint; USD cash close is retained for disclosure but never mixed with a differently scaled perp contract
